```yaml
name: Publish Skills to ClawHub

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Re-publish all skills'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

jobs:
  publish-skills:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed files
        id: get-changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          filter: '(\.skills\/.*|skill\.md)'

      - name: Check if any skill files changed
        id: check-changes
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ steps.get-changed-files.outputs.all }}" == "" ]] && [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            echo "No skill files changed, skipping publish"
            echo "skip_publish=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "skip_publish=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Setup ClawHub CLI
        if: env.skip_publish != 'true'
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/releases/download/v0.7.0/clawhub-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv clawhub /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Authenticate with ClawHub
        if: env.skip_publish != 'true'
        run: |
          clawhub login --token="${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}"

      - name: Publish changed skills
        if: env.skip_publish != 'true' && github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
        run: |
          CHANGED_SKILLS=(${{ steps.get-changed-files.outputs.added_modified }})
          for skill in "${CHANGED_SKILLS[@]}"; do
            if [[ "$skill" == .skills/* ]]; then
              echo "Publishing $skill"
              clawhub publish "$skill" --accept-license-terms
            fi
          done
          if [[ "${{ steps.get-changed-files.outputs.added }}" == *"skill.md"* ]] || [[ "${{ steps.get-changed-files.outputs.modified }}" == *"skill.md"* ]]; then
            echo "Publishing skill.md"
            clawhub publish "skill.md" --accept-license-terms
          fi

      - name: Publish all skills (force)
        if: env.skip_publish != 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.force == 'true'
        run: |
          find .skills -name "*.md" -type f | while read -r skill_file; do
            echo "Publishing $skill_file"
            clawhub publish "$skill_file" --accept-license-terms
          done
          echo "Publishing skill.md"
          clawhub publish "skill.md" --accept-license-terms
```
